subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

There was a general hesitation and ______ to ignore the problem.
solution:
The correct answer is "Demur."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"demur" **fits in the blank because it means to express hesitation, reluctance, or objection. (किसी बात पर आपत्ति करने या झिझकने की क्रिया या भाव)
 
• In the context of the sentence, it suggests that people were not readily willing to ignore the problem; instead, there was a collective sense of hesitation or reservation about doing so.
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *There was a general hesitation and **demur**__ to ignore the problem.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Denigrate: **to criticize somebody/something in an unfair way; to state that somebody/something is not good and does not have any importance or value. ((अनुचित तरीक़े से) आलोचना करना; नीचा दिखाना (महत्व या मूल्य कम करके); बुराई करना; बदनाम करना)
 
• **Disposition: **prevailing tendency, mood, or inclination. (प्रचलित प्रवृत्ति, मनोदशा, या झुकाव)
 
• **Deride: **to say that somebody/something is ridiculous; to laugh at something in a cruel way. (किसी को हास्‍यास्‍पद बताना; किसी का कठोरता से उपहास करना)
